construct: Verification bias occurs when receipt of the reference-standard test depends on the index-test result or related clinical suspicion, so disease status is not verified comparably across index-test groups and calculated diagnostic accuracy becomes biased.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: When biopsy verification depends on the index-test result or residual clinical suspicion and accuracy is calculated only among verified patients, the design has verification/workup bias.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Lead-time and length-time biases require screening/detection effects; recall bias requires differential memory; immortal-time bias requires time-dependent exposure classification. Selective application of the reference standard is specifically verification bias.
